findings.title: DATE_SHAPE checks the shape of the day, not that it exists: 2026-02-31 is stored as valid
findings.why_it_matters: The docstring promises that only valid bookings reach the database, and the day column is TEXT, so nothing downstream rejects 2026-02-31 or 2026-13-45. The start time is parsed with strptime, which does reject impossible values; the day needs the same.
findings.suggested_fix: Parse the day with date.fromisoformat(day) and raise on ValueError.
